notes.title: Team Battles Have Arrived
notes.content:
A new game mode is here, just in time for the holidays.

Team Battles allows you to join forces and fight as a team against an opposing armada!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982193/7580f8085589b42722d36faeb27de12fa8563922.png[/img]

notes.title: New Weapons and Options
notes.content:
[b]Missiles[/b] - Seek towards the nearest enemy
[b]Rifles[/b] - Instantly fire across the screen with deadly accuracy

Players now have the ability to control the gamespeed; %50, %100 or %125. Players can also decide which power-ups are available in treasure chests.

Thanks for playing,
Trevor

notes.title: New game modes have arrived!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982193/fa73d7103dfda56282164cde43fc8b092ed993f7.png[/img]

I am pleased to announce the rollout of 5 different game modes!
[list]
[*][b]Most Kills:[/b] Points are awarded for each kill
[*][b]Last Afloat:[/b] A point is awarded to the last player alive
[*][b]One Shot:[/b] Play with only 1 cannonball per player
[*][b]Hardcore:[/b] No bonus treasure, shots come fully charged
[*][b]Submerged:[/b] All players are submarines
[/list]

Please let me know if you have any other game mode ideas,
Trevor
